title: Not so sure this is calibrated properly
text: Not so sure this is calibrated properly. I guess the next time I buy an oven thermometer it better have a calibration certificate because I don't really trust this one

product_metadata.title: Taylor 3506 TruTemp Series Oven/Grill Analog Dial Thermometer with Dual-Scale
description: TRUTH Bimetal oven thermometer features a compact dual-scale dial with a brightly colored guide to make reading easier and a durable stainless steel casing and glass lens. Built-in hanger and stand works in any oven. Leave in oven to monitor temperatures. Hand wash only. Get more reliable, consistent results.
